ASSISTANT (message): Done. "Clear & cancel all" button live on the Tasks page.

**What it does:**
- Toolbar button next to "New Task" (destructive-tinted outline, `OctagonX` icon), disabled when nothing to cancel
- Click opens a confirm dialog stating exactly what happens: stops N live runs, cancels M open tasks (backlog / todo / in progress / in review / blocked). `done` and already-`cancelled` are untouched
- On confirm: cancels live heartbeat runs first (so agents can't flip statuses back mid-sweep), then PATCHes each open task to `cancelled`; per-item failures don't abort the rest. Refreshes the task list and live-runs queries afterward

**Implementation:** new `toolbarActions` slot on `IssuesList` (rendered after the create button), button + `Dialog` + mutation in `Issues.tsx` using the existing `heartbeatsApi.cancel` and `issuesApi.update` endpoints — no server changes needed.
